questions.question: Welche Epoche folgt direkt auf die Renaissance?
questions.explanation: Die Barockepoche begann im späten 16. Jahrhundert und folgte direkt auf die Renaissance. Diese Zeit war geprägt von prunkvoller Kunst, Architektur und einer starken politischen Macht der Monarchien in Europa.

questions.question: Which of the following structures was built in ancient Greece and is considered a significant example of Doric architecture?
choices: A: The Hanging Gardens of Babylon
questions.explanation: The Parthenon was built in the 5th century BC on the Acropolis of Athens and is an outstanding example of Doric architecture. It was constructed in honor of the goddess Athena and is a symbol of Greek culture and architecture.
